exposure: mothers who travelled >100km vs those who travelled less
mothers who attended antenatal care vs those who didn't
cohort: 206 pregnant women referred from rural healthcare facilities to central hospitals in Harare, Zimbabwe
finding: The study found a high rate of obstetric referrals from rural facilities to tertiary institutions, indicating shortcomings in primary and secondary healthcare facilities in Zimbabwe.
mod_finding: Delivering at the rural health facility was significantly associated with receiving a blood transfusion at the tertiary facility.
